requirement: Apply an update-clinical-metric command to an existing model: copy the name, description, version, publisher, and applied flag, refresh UpdatedAt, leave the immutable code untouched, and always report success.

preconditions.text: The target model is tracked but not yet saved

inputs.text: Command applied through the dependency overload
Command that tries to change the code
Command that switches the metric on (IsApplied = true)
Command that switches the metric off (IsApplied = false)
Command that changes every mutable field

returns.text: Success at ApplicationStatus.Success with no error
Name, description, version, publisher, and applied flag are overwritten
The code is immutable and stays unchanged
The applied flag follows the command

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the mapper always returns a successful result
